scene: A newly recorded software/license cost needs support and the year's amortization is being tested.
preparer_action: Inspect rights and selected additions/disposals, distinguish the nature of expenditure and recalculate the supported amortization.
reviewer_goal: Challenge rights, the recognition/capitalization basis, useful life and unsupported classifications; arithmetic is only part of the work.
professional_or_method_limit: No automatic recognition decision from a cost label or a successful amortization calculation.

scene: The asset register contains an addition, a disposal and changed depreciation for selected items.
preparer_action: Trace selected movements to support, inspect relevant assets, recalculate supported depreciation and record impairment/lease matters needing separate evaluation.
reviewer_goal: Challenge existence/rights, repair-versus-capital classification, timing, life/residual assumptions and the treatment of disposed assets.
professional_or_method_limit: A disposal/fully-depreciated flag is a candidate; impairment and lease conclusions require their actual supported work.

reviewer_goal: Challenge count-to-record coverage, ownership, method, units and the evidence for estimated realizable amounts.
professional_or_method_limit: Attendance itself is P09-UC05. Aging or a computed shortfall alone does not decide an inventory write-down.

reviewer_goal: Challenge whether subsequent cash relates to the selected debt and whether existence evidence also supports recovery; keep those assertions distinct.
professional_or_method_limit: A nonresponse is not agreement. An aging calculation is not an automatic allowance conclusion.

reviewer_goal: Challenge timing, contract interpretation, valuation and whether apparent repayment actually settles the selected receivable.

reviewer_goal: Challenge whether receipt/use supports release to the appropriate asset/expense and whether unsupported balances need further work.
professional_or_method_limit: A paid invoice does not alone establish that a prepayment was consumed in this period.

preparer_action: Trace selected purchase/payable items in the relevant direction, inspect cut-off and subsequent settlement, investigate matching differences and confirmations when used.

scene: A period-end liability relies on an estimate or a service not yet invoiced.
preparer_action: Inspect selected obligations, completeness and timing, recalculate the supported accrual and compare later support with the period-end basis.
reviewer_goal: Challenge obligation, period, method and omitted amounts; use the estimate case where judgment is significant.
professional_or_method_limit: A later invoice amount is not automatically the correct earlier accrual without its service/period basis.
